card.summary: No free tier. Four terms offered (30 / 90 / 180 / 365 days) with the price printed as 'Rp Call.000' - i.e. by quotation, no number published.

record.category: debrid resale - Indonesian agent that upgrades the buyer's account by hand

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable to the resale: the single-object cap is the debrid vendor's, not the shop's

retention.stated: not applicable to the resale: cached-item retention is the debrid vendor's

record.interface_detail: the shop delivers a voucher code or a login by email; the capacity itself is reached through the debrid vendor's REST API
record.tooling: any client that takes the vendor's API key: rclone, JDownloader, Stremio/Torrentio, pyload
record.chaining: a resold voucher only changes how the days are paid for; the stack above it is unchanged
record.binding_note: The seller must hold the buyer's credentials to deliver at all, and the vendor records connections: the delivery itself is the sharing event the terms describe.
record.confidence_note: the seller's page was read; a seller is not the vendor, so nothing here is at the documented rung except the vendor terms quoted in evidence

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Four terms offered (30 / 90 / 180 / 365 days) with the price printed as 'Rp Call.000' - i.e. by quotation, no number published.
free_tier.notes: the page's own notice: 'Sistem Payment produk ini belum otomatis, pelanggan harus mengirimkan userlogin dan password untuk kami upgrade secara manual. Estimasi waktu upgrade 1 s/d 48 jam'

egress.terms: no byte allowance published; the page sells 'download speed unlimited' as a vendor feature

limits.value: manual upgrade, 1-48 h on working days, after the buyer sends username and password
the seller logs in from Indonesia to perform the upgrade; the buyer logs in from elsewhere

identity_cost.detail: local Indonesian bank transfer (ATM, mobile banking, e-banking), no card and no PayPal; the order is a message in the format 'EMAIL // NAMA LENGKAP // MERK ACCOUNT // DURASI PAKET // NAMA BANK TUJUAN' (email, full name, product, term, bank)

record.reliability_note: Handing the seller the account password is the failure: the vendor's new-location check emails a PIN to the account's mailbox, and a login from the seller's IP is exactly the pattern its terms suspend.

evidence.proved: the manual-upgrade notice requiring username and password, the 1-48 h window, 'Rp Call.000' placeholders, and the nine-year trading claim
the order message carries email, full name, product, term and bank name
evidence.quote: EMAIL // NAMA LENGKAP // MERK ACCOUNT // DURASI PAKET // NAMA BANK TUJUAN

evidence.proved: payment is a rupiah transfer from a local Indonesian bank, without a credit card
evidence.quote: Cukup transfer rupiah dari bank lokal melalui ATM, Mobile Banking, atau ebanking di Indonesia maka

evidence.proved: payment is manual: the buyer sends login and password and the upgrade takes 1 to 48 hours on working days; the four terms still show 'Rp Call.000'
evidence.quote: Sistem Payment produk ini belum otomatis, pelanggan harus mengirimkan userlogin dan password untuk kami upgrade secara manual. Estimasi waktu upgrade 1 s/d 48 jam pada hari kerja.

record.notes: The only shop found whose delivery method requires the buyer's password. That makes it the clearest case of the category: the resale is not of days but of access, and access is what the vendor's identity checks are built to stop.

card.summary: No free tier of its own; it resells the vendor's free slot: 'Free - 150 MB, 1 Active, 1 Mbit/s, Free'. Its paid Indoleech ladder runs Rp 30,000 (10 GB) to Rp...

record.category: premium-account and voucher reseller (Indonesian: IDR pricing, local bank transfer)

free_tier.stated: No free tier of its own; it resells the vendor's free slot: 'Free - 150 MB, 1 Active, 1 Mbit/s, Free'. Its paid Indoleech ladder runs Rp 30,000 (10 GB) to Rp 440,000 (1024 GB) per 30 days.
free_tier.notes: Prices are quoted in thousands of rupiah without the 'Rp' prefix in the table ('30.000' = Rp 30,000).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: it sells the vendor's entitlement

egress.terms: Whatever the underlying service grants; ViooMax's own table restates 1 Gbit/s paid and unlimited download.

record.interface_detail: Web catalogue with an order form; the reseller describes buying by 'transfer rupiah dari bank lokal melalui ATM, Mobile Banking, atau ebanking'.
record.tooling: None to install; the buyer receives an account or voucher for the underlying service.
record.chaining: The workaround layer for the Indonesian payment gate: it converts an IDR bank transfer into a foreign service's premium entitlement. It chains with nothing itself and it exists only because the underlying sites cannot be paid for locally.

limits.value: manual order process; prices 'sewaktu-waktu bisa berubah karena perubahan kurs'

record.limits_note: Ordering is by contact form, not self-service checkout, so delivery depends on an operator.
record.binding_note: The reseller imposes no technical limit; whatever it resells binds after purchase.

identity_cost.detail: The site's selling point is the absence of international rails: 'pengguna ... Indonesia bisa memiliki account Indoleech Premium tanpa kartu kredit / credit card, tidak perlu akun Paypol, dll. Cukup transfer rupiah dari bank lokal melalui ATM, Mobile Banking, atau ebanking di Indonesia'. In practice that means an Indonesian bank account is required, which is the gate for anyone outside Indonesia.

record.reliability_note: Exchange-rate repricing is stated openly, delivery is manual, and the site's own copy is written for search engines rather than customers; there is no published refund or replacement policy on the page read.
record.confidence_note: The reseller page and its price table were read. Whether it accepts a foreign card is not stated anywhere on the page and is treated as unknown, not as accepted.

evidence.proved: 'tanpa kartu kredit / credit card, tidak perlu akun Paypol, dll. Cukup transfer rupiah dari bank lokal melalui ATM, Mobile Banking, atau ebanking di Indonesia'

price ladder: 'Torrent 10G 30.000 / 85.000 / 162.000 / 300.000', 'Torrent 1000G 1024 GB 30 Active 440.000 / 1.250.000 / 2.400.000 / 4.400.000'; 'Harga di atas sewaktu-waktu bisa berubah karena perubahan kurs'

record.price_per_tb_month: IDR 30,000 per 30 days for a 10 GB Indoleech slot; IDR 440,000 for 1 TB
record.notes: Cleanest example of a payment gate producing a local middleman: the reseller's entire pitch is 'no credit card, no PayPal'. It also resells Debrid-Link, LinkSnappy and Katfile, so it is the Indonesian on-ramp to the global debrid market.

extras.resells: Indoleech, Debrid-Link, LinkSnappy, Katfile, and others
extras.self_description: 'reseller / agen resmi Account Premium berlisensi di Indonesia'
